blocks.text: DAVAO CITY – The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in the Soccsksargen region on Tuesday said that a Philippine Eagle (Pithecophaga jefferyi) was found dead in Barangay Libertad of Arakan, Cotabato, on Sunday, October 4, three days after another died from electrocution in Salay, Misamis Oriental. Philippine Eagle “Arakan” was also reportedly electrocuted by a power line. According to its social media post, the DENR-Community Environment and Natural Resources Office in Matalam said the eagle “had electrical burn marks on its left wing and on two digits of its right talon.” READ: PEF confirms eagle in Misamis Oriental died […]...
